completion.objective_definition: Original deadline-feasible incentive matching; relax deadlines only on empty assignments in full-visit mode. Heuristic for on-time completion, not a global maximum-completion solver.

cost.objective_definition: Hungarian minimum predicted added deadline cost: 0 when finish <= deadline, otherwise finish/deadline. All remaining tasks are eligible, including late ones. Equal-cost assignments follow SciPy deterministic row/task order. If the current robot is unmatched when tasks are fewer than robots, select its minimum-cost task. Visits every task; local matching does not guarantee minimum final schedule cost.
